sonnet.problem: The joke uses the same punchline shape as several earlier cards: 'Friend, that's [everyday comparison]'. Stop 1 card 6 ('Friend, that's a cleaner record than my apron has EVER had'), stop 1 card 11 ('that's THREE') and this card ('That's the ding on your phone, friend') all use it, and stop 2 card 11 ('Friend, that's me when the smoke alarm goes off') uses it again.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
